title: MCP list_changed Notification Support (v2.1.89)
description: Claude Code now handles MCP list_changed notifications from MCP servers, allowing servers to dynamically update their available tools, prompts, and resources mid-session without requiring a disconnect and reconnect. Enables MCP servers that add tools after user actions (e.g., after authentication, after selecting a project). Complements existing tool loading optimizations.
redundancy_notes: No existing dynamic MCP tool registration mechanism in registry. Previously, tool list changes required session restart. NOVEL — enables a new server design pattern. Particularly relevant for claude.ai connector MCPs that authenticate lazily.

evaluation.reasoning: Zero configuration required — Claude Code automatically handles list_changed notifications from compliant MCP servers. Official Anthropic v2.1.89 feature. Capability expansion 60: enables MCP servers to add tools post-auth without reconnect — directly relevant for the claude.ai connector MCPs (Gmail, Calendar, Scholar) which authenticate lazily and likely use this pattern to expose their full tool set after auth. Token efficiency 55: minor improvement by eliminating reconnect overhead; also prevents stale tool caches. Zero maintenance (protocol-level behavior). Integration action: document in registry as active behavior; note that claude.ai connector MCPs are the primary beneficiary in this workspace.
